title: China publicly discloses plan for a lunar landing within three years
gist: China publicly laid out a stepwise plan toward a crewed lunar landing 'before 2030' using dual Long March 10 launches with the Mengzhou spacecraft and Lanyue lander, with test flights in 2027, 2028 and 2029. NASA targets 2028 but lander uncertainty could push a US landing to 2030 or later, setting up a geopolitical race now being met by Isaacman's Artemis streamlining.

insights.claim: China is making credible progress despite opacity, including an August 2025 tethered landing/takeoff test of a high-fidelity 26-ton Lanyue mock-up, and Mengzhou arriving at Wenchang for the 2027 test.
